title: 2026-10-19 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：Efficient KV Cache Migration for Geo-Distributed LLM Inference in Collaborative Edge Computing (The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, 边缘场景下 KV 迁移的最优解不是全传或全算，而是让传输与重算并行分摊。)、LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training (University of Cambridge, 把编解码做成 GPU kernel 后，无损压缩的收益可以覆盖它的开销。)、PriorityFEC: Deadline-Aware Streaming FEC for KV-Cache Handoff in Edge Multi-Agent Systems (机构未标注, 边缘 KV 交接先送最值钱的块，再用 FEC 补齐，才算得过 TTFT 这笔账。)

highlights.name: AbridgeKV
highlights.note: 训练模型把长推理压进 pause token 的 KV，四分之一缓存精度不掉

highlights.name: EdgeFlow
highlights.note: KV 直传与激活重计算并行编排，边缘迁移时间降 45%

highlights.name: LCT
highlights.note: GPU 上的无损 Huffman 张量压缩，Qwen3-4B 峰值显存省 23.8%
